plugins.name: claude-md-optimizer
plugins.description: Analyzes and optimizes CLAUDE.md files following Anthropic's official best practices. Use when reviewing existing CLAUDE.md for improvements, or when user mentions CLAUDE.md is too long or ineffective.

plugins.name: mindfulness-mentor
plugins.description: Guides developers through mindfulness exercises and stress-reduction techniques. Use when taking a break, feeling overwhelmed, debugging frustration, or needing to refocus during a coding session.

plugins.name: do-registry-cleanup
plugins.description: Analyze and clean DigitalOcean Container Registry images. Lists repos with tag counts, deletes old tags (keep last N), finds stale repos, triggers garbage collection. Supports dry-run mode.

plugins.name: devops-skills
plugins.description: Multi-cloud DevOps workflows across 13 skills: Terraform/OpenTofu plan review and state surgery, Terragrunt CLI redesign and stacks, Kubernetes day-to-day operations, Kubernetes Operators (CRD/reconcile/OperatorHub), Docker workflows, ArgoCD ApplicationSets and GitOps posture, GCP IAM inheritance and impersonation, S3-compatible storage identification, GitHub Actions OIDC and reusable workflows, Cloudflare DNS zones (REST), Cloudflare `cf` unified CLI (preview), AWS CodePipeline + CodeBuild, AWS cost investigation (Cost Explorer + CUR). Covers AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean, Azure, Cloudflare.

plugins.name: digitalocean-skills
plugins.description: DigitalOcean operations skills. Currently: DNS zones via doctl, the DigitalOcean API v2, and the digitalocean Terraform provider — domain/record CRUD, the apex CNAME / no-flattening trap when migrating from Cloudflare, account-wide token handling, FQDN trailing-dot semantics, DNS-01 ACME wildcard certs, and nameserver delegation.

plugins.name: setup-project-skills
plugins.description: Installs skills from a user-curated manifest (~/.claude/skill-manifest.json) into the current project's .claude/skills/ — symlinks local skills, runs `npx skills add` for third-party ones, and advises `/plugin install` for native Claude plugins. Optionally scans the project for trigger files and pre-selects recommended matches. Ships a starter manifest as skill-manifest.example.json.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Curated upstream: Cloudflare's official platform skills — Workers, Pages, KV/D1/R2, Workers AI, Vectorize, Agents SDK, Tunnel, Spectrum, WAF, DDoS, Terraform, Pulumi. Includes the wrangler, agents-sdk, durable-objects, sandbox-sdk, web-perf, building-mcp-server-on-cloudflare, building-ai-agent-on-cloudflare, and cloudflare-email-service skills.

plugins.name: vercel-react-skills
plugins.description: Curated upstream: Vercel-Labs React/Next.js skills — performance best practices, composition patterns (compound components, render props), and React Native / Expo conventions for mobile.
